x-agent-guidelines.purpose: Standard instructions for AI/coding agents when creating or updating this project.
x-agent-guidelines.scope: K2NET Portal (k2net-portal / k2netid/portal); downstream of ja-core_engine. Product identity: K2NET / layung. Kernel bugfixes: dual-commit upstream.
when_creating_or_updating_project: Read AGENTS.md first, then docs/WORKFLOW.md, docs/DOCUMENTATION.md, docs/AGENT_START_HERE.md (downstream banner), and ops handoff under ../docs/ja-dev/k2net/.
Do not rewrite mirrored docs/guides|reference|architecture (see .upstream-sot.md); put K2NET-specific docs in AGENTS.md, product/work/ADR lokal, or seeders.
For scale M+ work: create/update a brief under docs/work/ from docs/templates/task-brief.md (audit → plan → implement → verify → record).
Use branch-based workflow; avoid direct edits on main unless explicitly requested.
Prefer package managers for dependency changes (npm/composer), avoid manual lockfile edits.
Keep changes minimal and focused; avoid unrelated refactors.
Do not commit secrets or environment-specific credentials.
Update dual-layer changelogs per docs/guides/update-changelog.md when behavior or system docs change.
After edits, run npm run agent:verify before proposing merge.
handover_checklist: Summarize risky files touched and behavior changes.
Ensure working tree is clean before final handover.
